parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, refer to [How to ensure idempotence](~~25965~~).

parameters.name: ForceAttach
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to add the ECS instances or elastic container instances in the current scaling group to the new virtual service groups.

- true: adds the instances.

- false: does not add the instances.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides, such as ap-southeast-1. For more information, refer to [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: VServerGroup
parameters.description: The collection of information about the virtual service groups associated with the scaling group.

sub_parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the load balancing instance to which the virtual service group belongs. N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.
